{why}

Why Choose Objective-C?

Compatibility with C+ and C++ Libraries

Objective-C is applicable for all iOS versions, and, at the same time, it’s a superset of the C language. This means you can hire objective C Plus Plus developers to build your app’s backend. C+ and C++ boast large libraries that allow iOS engineers to add functionality without writing codes from scratch.

Usage of Private APIs Made Easy

Private APIs can, for example, help programmers get the functionality not yet released, debug the code, resolve a specific platform’s issue, etc. However, their insecurity makes private APIs unavailable in Swift. Here’s when Objective C for Swift developers works best, uniting the capabilities of the two languages.

It Builds Stable Applications

Though Objective-C won’t get new features, it has a set of well-established and tried-and-tested tools and frameworks. With 30+ years of history, this programming language offers mature code and straightforward integration with C++ opportunities. This makes Objective-C the instrument for developing highly reliable and stable iOS apps.

Feature-Rich

Every Objective C developer would agree that this programming language can do a lot. For instance, it allows for the creation of reusable code modules due to its object-oriented nature. Also, engineers can write codes faster as Objective-C allows for dynamic and static type declaration. This translates into an opportunity to make codebases shorter.

Time-Tested Language

Objective-C appeared in the 1980s, so it’s rather mature. However, it’s still in use, remaining compatible with C and newer Swift. Also, Objective C for C++ programmers is easy to learn. Thousands of companies (including large tech ones) have codebases in Objective-C and are not going to move to Swift.

FAQs on Hiring Objective C Developers

What will the development look like after I hire remote Objective C developers with Mobilunity?

First, we’ll analyze your project requirements and identify the tech stack. You’ll get an estimate for timeframes and budgets, and we negotiate it. Once it’s agreed, your coders start working on the project split into sprints. At the end of each stage, you get a demo and make changes if necessary.

Do you offer assistance with Objective C developer technical interviews?

Absolutely, our services include assistance for Objective C developer technical interviews, available for an extra fee. We ensure these interviews are conducted by top experts in Objective C, essential for teams without this specialization. A comprehensive summary and insights from the interviewer will be provided.

How will the communication with my development team run?

When you hire Objective C developers with us, you have two options to manage it. The first is handling the project yourself by appointing a PM. Also, we can provide you with an experienced PM. In this case, Mobilunity will arrange regular calls, send reports, and inform you of any project-related changes. This way, you’ll learn about the changes and be able to say what you think of them.

What apps can I build with Objective-C?

This programming language works for any functionality and industry. So, you can hire Objective C developer for this task if you need e-commerce, delivery, healthcare, real estate, communication, social media, game app, etc.

What’s the cost of developing an Objective-C application?

It can start at $5,000 and go up to $200,000. App size, functionalities, security, maintenance, and monthly cost to hire remote Objective C Plus Plus developers are the factors impacting the total spending. Each Mobilunity client gets this estimate after the discovery call.

How will my Objective-C developers optimize app performance?

The team you hire will use the best practices when building and improving apps. Your devs will optimize algorithms, implement asynchronous programming, remove memory leaks, enable asset slicing, minimize resolutions, and more. Also, profiling techniques help coders identify and address performance issues.
